يجتنب (form VIII)
# يَجْتَنِبُ (yajtanibu) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ni.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# يُجْتَنَبُ (yujtanabu) /jud͡ʒ.ta.na.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# يَجْتَنِبَ (yajtaniba) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ni.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
